- **EP-WAS atlas**: No variable called `LBXFAKE` was found. The system suggested the closest match (`LBXFER` — ferritin), but that's a different analyte entirely.
- **CompTox / chemical identity**: No chemical record found for `LBXFAKE`.

### What this means

There is no NHANES variable code `LBXFAKE`, so there are no cycles, effect sizes, or health associations to cite. The name "perfluorinated diol" also doesn't correspond to any chemical measured in NHANES. NHANES does measure several **per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)**, including:

| Variable | Chemical |
|---|---|
| `LBXPFOA` | Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) |
| `LBXPFOS` | Perfluorooctane sulfonic acid (PFOS) |
| `LBXPFHS` | Perfluorohexane sulfonic acid (PFHxS) |
| `LBXPFNA` | Perfluorononanoic acid (PFNA) |
| `LBXPFDE` | Perfluorodecanoic acid (PFDA) |
| `LBXMFOS` | Methyl-PFOS (sm-PFOS) |
| `LBXNFOS` | N-ethyl PFOSA (Et-PFOSA-AcOH) |

**I won't fabricate results for a variable that doesn't exist.** If you're interested in the health associations of any real PFAS compound (or any other NHANES exposure), I'd be happy to pull those for you — just let me know which one!
